source: NUS-3D fictional gameplay controls; nonofficial campus guide

tips.en_body: Use WASD to move and hold Shift to run. The deadline is not slowing down.
tips.zh_body: WASD 移动，按住 Shift 奔跑。DDL 可不会等你。

tips.en_body: Press M for the campus map or F1 to review the controls. No ugly arrow signs required.
tips.zh_body: 按 M 打开地图，按 F1 查看操作。我们不靠土味指路牌。

tips.en_body: Open Coursework Journal with P or use Shift+P to switch faculties. The group project awaits.
tips.zh_body: 按 P 打开 Coursework 任务手册，按 Shift+P 切换学院。组队作业已经在等你。

tips.en_body: Press B for the bicycle and X near the shuttle stop. Explore beyond the first plaza.
tips.zh_body: 按 B 使用自行车，在校车站附近按 X 乘车。别只在广场转圈。

tips.en_body: Explore ERC and SRC with I. Look for activity zones and use F to interact.
tips.zh_body: 按 I 进入 ERC 或 SRC 室内，在活动区域按 F 参与互动。

tips.en_body: Find Field Notes with C and try the campus sprint with V. Your best run counts.
tips.zh_body: 按 C 收集 Field Notes，按 V 参加校园冲刺。试着刷新成绩。

tips.en_body: Press Z to pick up coins. Collect a lunch order at Fine Food and deliver it with N.
tips.zh_body: 按 Z 捡金币，在 Fine Food 接午餐订单，用 N 送到指定地点。

tips.en_body: Equip cartoon toys with 1, 2 or 3. Student NPCs take snack breaks in silly duels.
tips.zh_body: 按 1、2、3 切换搞笑玩具。学生 NPC 在滑稽对决后会去吃零食休息。

tips.en_body: Open English major exam papers with F8. Pass the quiz to earn coursework rewards.
tips.zh_body: 按 F8 打开英文专业试卷，完成测验可获得课程奖励。

tips.en_body: Use Y to change the weather and F7 to hide the HUD for campus photos.
tips.zh_body: 按 Y 切换天气，按 F7 隐藏 HUD，拍一张不带界面的校园照片。

tips.en_body: Finish enough coursework to unlock the lounge: chess, cards and other ways to avoid work.
tips.zh_body: 完成一定数量的 Coursework 后解锁休闲区，下棋、打牌都安排上。
